editorial: Returning to the heart of 'Ohana, the latest Lilo & Stitch iteration proves that even the wildest, most mischievous little aliens can't escape the deep-seated emotional bond of family. The film is a vibrant, genuinely heartwarming blend of Hawaiian culture and sci-fi comedy, delivering the comfort of nostalgia while adding fresh, poignant stakes. It’s a beautiful reminder that home is not a place, but a feeling.
